How to Use
Rinse with warm water before first use.
Fill with room-temperature drinking water at night.
Drink through the next day; refill daily.
Care & Cleaning
  • Hand wash only. Not dishwasher or microwave safe.
  • Once a week, scrub inside and out with lemon and salt (or tamarind), rinse and dry.
  • Dry upside down with the cap off.
Why Copper Changes Colour
Copper naturally darkens and can develop a patina when it meets air and water. This is normal and not a defect. A quick lemon-and-salt scrub brings back the shine.

Questions, answered

How long should water stay in the bottle?
Fill it at night and drink it through the next day. Empty, rinse and refill daily.
Will the cap leak in a bag?
The screw cap has a silicone seal. Close it fully and keep the bottle upright for the first few uses to make sure it's seated properly.
Why has my bottle turned dark?
That's natural oxidation, not damage. See Care & Cleaning to restore the shine in a minute.
Can I put hot water or lemon water in it?
No. Use it for plain, room-temperature water only.
What if it arrives dented?
Share an unboxing photo within 48 hours and we'll send a free replacement. See Shipping, Returns & Replacement.
